headers.scan_lift:
(e : StoredEdges.Edge) (r : Record) (rs acc : List Record)
    {k : ℕ} {s t : StoredEdges.State} (ht : Trace StoredEdges.transition k s t) :
    Trace (transition e) k (.scan r rs acc s) (.scan r rs acc t)
headers.records_trace:
(e : StoredEdges.Edge) (rs acc : List Record) :
    Trace (transition e) (scanSteps e rs) (.records rs acc)
      (.reverse ((selected e rs).reverse++acc) [])
headers.reverse_trace:
(e : StoredEdges.Edge) (rs out : List Record) :
    Trace (transition e) (rs.length+1) (.reverse rs out) (.halt (rs.reverse++out))
headers.prepare_trace:
(e : StoredEdges.Edge) (rs : List Record) :
    Trace (transition e) (scanSteps e rs+(selected e rs).length+1)
      (.records rs []) (.halt (selected e rs))
